correctness.rationale: Overlap-graph vertices (a,b,c) with a!=b,b!=c number q(q-1)^2. Allowed four-edges are (a,b,c,d) with a!=b,b!=c,c!=d,(a,b)!=(c,d); at repeated-endpoint vertices a=c both in/out degrees q-2, otherwise q-1. Each ternary-restricted induced graph is strongly connected; sharing two-symbol repeated-endpoint vertices connects all 3-symbol subgraphs, proving global connectivity for q>=3. Elimination to ordered-pair coordinates splits the Laplacian into a constant, (q-1) standard 2x2 blocks, symmetric row-sum-zero and antisymmetric row-sum-zero components, dimensions totaling q(q-1). Determinants produce the claimed factors x, (x-q+1)^A, Q_q(x)^B and P_q(x)^(q-1). Directed matrix-tree and BEST with unique edge labels yield the all-q expression. Independently constructed Laplacians at q=3 and 4 have exact characteristic polynomials matching factorization; exact arborescence counts are 12 and 49589822592000. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace the invariant-subspace proof.
